scope.en: Submission-time build, static analysis and packaged-model functional checks only. No latency benchmark or full-dataset accuracy evaluation was rerun. Timings contained in the raw smoke-test reports are incidental and must not replace historical measurements.

limitations: Debug builds and targeted physical-device functional tests were verified; no release/R8 build was run in this cleanup pass.
The Pixel 8a uses 4096-byte pages. APK zipalign and native ELF inspection are static evidence, not a 16KB-device compatibility claim.

Both APKs still contain 4096-byte ELF LOAD alignment in armeabi-v7a/libobjectbox-jni.so and armeabi-v7a/libtranslate_jni.so. Their arm64-v8a counterparts and the new XNNPACK bridge meet 16384-byte ELF alignment.
Ktlint retains 157 existing baseline entries across 45 files. Detekt retains the 26 verified historical findings. Android Lint retains 55 warnings per flavor.
The initial Java invocation failed before compilation with a loopback/temp-path environment error; the documented JDK17/short-temp invocation completed all checks.
